name: Desert Search and Rescue after Sandstorm
mission_theme: Featureless dunes, buried track, one stranded vehicle: wide search, thermal detection and a long wadi transit.

task_generation.rule: tasks are instantiated from the 10 task templates with scenario-specific parameters; composite tasks add contingency patterns that combine two templates

tasks.title: Search and rescue sweep of AREA-DUNE-N (sweep 120 m, beacon in C4)
tasks.brief: A distress beacon is active somewhere in AREA-DUNE-N. Sweep the area cooperatively at 100 m with 120 m spacing between tracks so that at least 95% of the area is observed once. When a UAV detects the signal, localise it to within 25 m, mark the spot (hover >= 10 s and transmit the position) and hand the position to the rescue element. Do not leave uncovered strips when the first detection happens.
tasks.objective: Sweep AREA-DUNE-N with 4 UAVs at 100 m using a 120 m sweep width until the distress beacon is detected, localised to within 25 m and marked.

actions: report the beacon to the team

constraints: minimum separation 25 m
no flight inside the marked danger radius before the rescue element arrives
failure_conditions: beacon not detected within the window
marked position error above 40 m
abandoning the sweep to chase a false signal

checkpoints.metric: area observed at least once before task end

checkpoints.name: Detection
checkpoints.metric: beacon detection event
checkpoints.target: detected before the task window closes

checkpoints.name: Localisation
checkpoints.metric: error of the transmitted beacon position

checkpoints.name: Marking and handover
checkpoints.metric: hover time at the beacon and handover message
checkpoints.target: hover >= 10 s and handover message sent

checkpoints.name: No uncovered strip
checkpoints.metric: uncovered strips left when detection happens

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Coverage survey of BLOCK-ROAD-1 (90% target, 2 UAVs)
tasks.brief: Your team must survey the block BLOCK-ROAD-1 completely. Fly parallel tracks at 110 m AGL with 25 % side overlap and keep every UAV 25 m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least 90 %. Recover to LZ-CAMP when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.

actions: assign one strip set per UAV
mission_phases.output: track plan with strip ids and entry points

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap
declare complete or request a re-fly

constraints: minimum separation 25 m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task
no manual pilot override
failure_conditions: any UAV leaves the geofence
any UAV enters a no-fly zone
coverage below 60% when the task window closes
loss-of-control or collision flag

constraints: hover only at declared capture points

constraints: relay altitude >= 180 m - 20 m

failure_conditions: link down for more than 60 s in total

tasks.title: Mission continuity after losing UAV-2 and UAV-4 at t=900 s
tasks.brief: At about t = 900 s, UAV-2 and UAV-4 are lost (link and telemetry gone). The mission still needs at least 55 % of the AREA-DUNE-N work done. Re-plan the surviving fleet, protect the critical core of the plan, and declare what is dropped and why. Do not launch a search for the lost UAVs.
tasks.objective: Keep the mission-critical core of AREA-DUNE-N running after UAV-2 and UAV-4 are lost at t = 900 s, delivering at least 55 % of the original plan with the surviving UAVs.

actions: detect the loss of UAV-2 and UAV-4
report dropped work and residual risk

constraints: surviving UAVs may not leave the geofence
no new tasks after t = 900 s
failure_conditions: abandoning the critical core
searching for lost UAVs
no statement within 180 s

checkpoints.name: Loss declaration
checkpoints.metric: time from loss to acknowledged statement

checkpoints.name: Continuity
checkpoints.metric: fraction of the original plan delivered

checkpoints.name: Critical core
checkpoints.metric: coverage of AREA-DUNE-N after the loss

checkpoints.name: No futile search
checkpoints.metric: time spent searching for the lost UAVs

checkpoints.name: Report
checkpoints.metric: continuity report submitted
checkpoints.target: report lists dropped tasks with reasons

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted
